Core Domain

Frontend & Interface Engineering

Crafting visually refined, mobile-first, responsive user interfaces that deliver intuitive experiences across smartphones, tablets, laptops, and ultra-wide screens.

Semantic HTML5 & Accessibility (a11y)

Valid semantic markup, proper heading hierarchy, ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, and screen-reader accessibility.

Modern CSS & Responsive Layout Systems

CSS Grid, Flexbox, custom CSS custom properties (variables), subtle micro-interactions, responsive fluid typography, and glassmorphism styling.

Interactive JavaScript & UI Logic

Vanilla JavaScript, DOM manipulation, client-side form validation, mobile drawer interactions, dynamic filters, and API integrations.

Computing & Systems

Backend & Database Architecture

With strong backend development skills documented in my CV and demonstrated in the Academic Results Processing System (ERM) and IkonCloud educational SaaS platform.

Server-Side Logic & Frameworks

Backend development using Python (Django / DjangoCon Africa participation), PHP, and scalable RESTful API design.

Database Schema & Data Integrity

Relational database design (MySQL, PostgreSQL), normalized schemas, secure queries, and automated grading algorithm pipelines.

Educational SaaS & Dynamic Reporting

Architecting cloud platforms for school data management, dynamic PDF report card generation, and automated communication.

Search & Visibility

Technical SEO & Digital Marketing

Applying the full modern SEO checklist for real commercial discoverability on Google, ensuring clean indexability, high click-through rates, and strong local authority.

Technical SEO Foundations

Robots.txt management, XML sitemap generation, canonical URL structures, HTTP-to-HTTPS enforcement, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

On-Page Architecture & Structured Data

Targeted page titles, compelling meta descriptions, single semantic H1s, internal link graphs, and Schema.org JSON-LD (Person, WebSite, Service).

Local SEO & Brand Consistency

Consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) citation standards, Google Business Profile readiness, and regional East African search targeting.
